description: Collecting voice samples from a meeting: who may collect, add, hear and delete.

preconditions: A sample was collected at the meeting; actor is its current secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: its current secretary; sampleId: a sample collected there.
cases.return: Success with the sample id (MSG474 "Đã xoá giọng mẫu thu hộ.").
cases.log: Saved: sample removed; audit row records the deletion with the meeting scope.

preconditions: The sample is one the person recorded themself; actor is a secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: a meeting; actorId: its current secretary; sampleId: the person own self-recorded sample.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; a secretary never touches the person own set.

preconditions: A sample was collected at the meeting; actor takes part but is not the secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actorId: a member who is not the secretary; sampleId: a sample collected there.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; answered as if the meeting does not exist.
